description: This PHP class defines a view component for displaying geocoding counts and related information in the SuiteCRM module 'jjwg_Maps'. It outputs HTML content showing geocoded address counts, status, and links for geocoding operations and data export.

classes.name: Jjwg_MapsViewGeocoded_Counts
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView for rendering geocoded counts and controls.

methods.description: Constructor method that invokes parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the HTML content for the geocoded counts page, including tables, links, and instructions.
